recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current CodeableReference(Any) representation satisfies the reference-capable reason requirement after later datatype refactoring; do not reintroduce separate reason[x] or reasonReference elements for this STU3 tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-13638 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request raised and applied for STU3 asking that Task.reason become a choice including Reference() because a Task can be justified by an Observation, Condition, past or planned procedure, or similar resource.
initial_application: The request appears to have been applied in git commit bc96ecb06628ee69c3400a6936e333a7e379d363, whose message names GF#13638. That STU3-era source changed the Task spreadsheet from one Task.reason CodeableConcept to split Task.reasonCode and Task.reasonReference, with reasonReference typed Reference(Any).
additional_context: Task remains active in source/fhir.ini. Later same-family Task issues changed the representation: FHIR-25255 replaced reasonCode and reasonReference with 0..* Task.reason CodeableReference, and FHIR-37905 added the Resource target profile that renders as CodeableReference(Any). FHIR-37905 is already represented on the combined branch by commit 013db94ba67d4657e98f35f89a42af9d7a46b85b.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current source/task/structuredefinition-Task.xml defines Task.reason as 0..* CodeableReference with targetProfile http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Resource, source/fhir.ini maps the old reasonCode and reasonReference paths into reason.concept and reason.reference, and no active Task.reasonCode or Task.reasonReference elements remain.

related_jiras.note: Co-applied in the same historical commit as FHIR-13638 but concerned ProcedureRequest reason comments rather than Task.reason reference support.
Published R5 same-family Task issue that replaced Task.reasonCode and Task.reasonReference with 0..* Task.reason CodeableReference.
Applied R6 same-family Task issue that clarified Task.reason should be CodeableReference(Any); already audited on the combined branch.
